author: Frank O Aylward

steps.title: Download S. aureus genome
steps.instruction: Use wget to download the compressed genome file from NCBI: wget ftp://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/genomes/all/GCF/000/009/585/GCF_000009585.1_ASM958v1/GCF_000009585.1_ASM958v1_genomic.fna.gz

steps.title: List directory contents
steps.instruction: List files in the current folder with ls; for human‑readable sizes use ls -lh; to list only text files use ls *.txt

steps.title: Create project directory
steps.instruction: Make a new folder named test_project: mkdir test_project

steps.title: Enter project directory and show path
steps.instruction: Change into the new folder and display the full path: cd test_project && pwd

steps.title: Uncompress genome gzip file
steps.instruction: Decompress the downloaded .gz file, producing a .fna file: gunzip GCF_000009585.1_ASM958v1_genomic.fna.gz

steps.title: Preview genome file with head/tail/more
steps.instruction: Inspect the first and last lines of the FASTA file and scroll through it: head GCF_000009585.1_ASM958v1_genomic.fna ; tail GCF_000009585.1_ASM958v1_genomic.fna ; more GCF_000009585.1_ASM958v1_genomic.fna

steps.title: Count FASTA entries with grep
steps.instruction: Count how many sequences are present by searching for lines that start with ">": grep "^>" GCF_000009585.1_ASM958v1_genomic.fna

steps.title: Get file statistics with wc
steps.instruction: Obtain line, word, and byte counts for the genome file: wc GCF_000009585.1_ASM958v1_genomic.fna

steps.title: Pipe grep output to wc
steps.instruction: Combine grep and wc to count FASTA headers in one command: grep "^>" GCF_000009585.1_ASM958v1_genomic.fna | wc
